header: Head-on with obstacle, earlier run  ·  Gemini Robotics-ER 2
camera_label: Left: real overhead camera of the simulation (topic /perception/annotated_frame). The boxes and robot ids were drawn on it by the perception module (M1) during the run.
intro_title: Head-on with obstacle: an earlier recorded run
intro_lines: Recorded 2026-09-30 on an earlier code version; not part of the 2026-11-15 campaign. Same scene as the head-on take: two robots meet nose to nose in a narrow aisle between two barriers, with an obstacle near the west end.
When a robot has been stuck for 12 s, the system asks a vision-language model (VLM) what to do: it sends a text prompt and the current camera image, checks the answer, and executes it.
Robots: 2  ·  Model: Gemini Robotics-ER 2 (gemini-robotics-er-2-preview)  ·  One run (n = 1), selected because the model's choice was executed without correction.
Left: real overhead camera of the simulation. Right: the run's own logs, replayed in sync with simulation time.
watch_for: Which robot the model chooses to back out (yellow lines on the right).
Whether the check keeps or swaps that choice (orange line).
Which parts of the manoeuvre are the system's rather than the model's.

captions.text: The two robots drive toward each other into the aisle under their normal navigation (Nav2).
Trigger: robot_1 has been stuck for 12 s. The system sends the model a text prompt and the current camera image; the wait for its answer plays in real time.
Model's answer: yield, with robot_2 as the robot that backs out so robot_1 can pass.
Check: the feasibility gate kept the model's choice (yield_robot_grounded_from = null: no swap).
Dispatch: robot_2 is sent 'yield' (back out and pull aside); robot_1 is told to wait.
robot_2 has backed out and stepped aside. The system now escorts robot_1 past it.

at.match: robot robot_1 arrived at base goal

captions.text: robot_1 has reached its goal. robot_2 resumes its own drive under Nav2.
robot_2's own drive stalled. The model is asked three times and answers 'no congestion'; nothing is sent.
robot_2 moves again after Nav2's own recovery (the system's, not the model's).

at.match: robot robot_2 arrived at base goal

outcome.text: Outcome: VLM-driven execution: the model's yielder was kept by the gate and executed. 2 of 2 robots arrived.

legend: Legend: yield = back out and pull aside so the other robot passes · temporary_wait = hold still · yield_robot_grounded_from = the yielder the model named before a gate swap (null = no swap) · 'safety stop … min_distance_violation' (dim) = robots closer than 0.45 m are held still by the safety monitor.
disclosure: Illustrative demo, not controlled experimental evidence. Earlier run (2026-09-30), not part of the campaign.
outro_lines: The model's: the congestion call, the strategy 'yield' and the choice of robot_2 as the yielder; the feasibility gate kept the choice.
The system's: when to ask; the back-out distance; robot_1's wait; the escort of robot_1 past robot_2; the return to the normal mission; Nav2's recovery after robot_2 stalled (sim ~97–120 s).

Caveats: an earlier code version. It predates the current 0.20 m hard floor (on centre distance) and the safety-exemption fix; closest centre distance 0.264 m, body-to-body gap 0.19 m. One run, selected because it qualifies. In the 2026-11-15 take of this scene the model chose the other robot and the gate swapped it.
